summary: Craft shaping completed before any site-code modification, per /impeccable craft: read PRODUCT.md, the seed DESIGN.md, BRAND_SOURCE.md and prospect.json, then read reference/craft.md, reference/shape.md and reference/brand.md from the provisioned skill. Register is brand (design IS the product). Confirmed direction: 'A Trilha ate a Vida' (The Path to Life) — the three evidenced education stages (Ensino Infantil, Ensino Fundamental I e II, Ensino Medio) become a single literal path the visitor walks stage by stage, rendered as a continuous side rule that deepens in color as the stages mature (white/near-white Infantil field to a deep dusk-toned admissions chapter for Medio and the visit), turning the school's own life-preparation promise ('Educando para a vida') into a light-to-dusk color arc instead of a generic timeline-with-icons or hero-plus-card-grid template. This harness has no native image generation (Codex image_gen), so per craft.md Step 3 the mock-generation step is explicitly skipped and this written direction is treated as the visual contract. No downloadable logo, photo, or screenshot file exists in the supplied evidence (brand_source.visual_assets and original_screenshots resolve only to the live page URLs, not files) — the honest choice, matching sibling builds in this pipeline, is zero photography and zero stock substitution, using only original CSS-native trail/path devices. Typography pairing: DejaVu Serif (display, sturdy/humanist, resolves locally, not on the overused-font or reflex-reject list) against DejaVu Sans / Liberation Sans (body/UI), a genuine serif-vs-sans contrast pair, chosen deliberately over reusing Georgia (already the display choice on two sibling school builds in this same pipeline run). Four distinct art-directed moments planned: (1) an asymmetric threshold hero carrying a real semantic H1 (fixing the sourced no-H1 defect) plus an inline visit strip (hours/phone) on the first screen, (2) an alternating editorial trail spread for the three stages (not a repeated card grid, not numbered-marker scaffolding — the sequence is a real chronological progression the reader walks, each stage given a distinct compositional treatment rather than identical cards), (3) a centered values/founding statement carrying the verified 1990 founding and the verbatim public language, (4) a full-bleed deep dusk admissions chapter surfacing address/hours/phone/email together (fixing the sourced contact-hidden-from-homepage defect). Color evolution is one-directional light-to-dark mapped onto the age progression, not a decorative palette swap. Every planned color pairing was pre-checked analytically against WCAG AA before implementation; will be re-verified against rendered computed styles during the browser pass. Evidence boundary: only prospect.json / PRODUCT.md / BRAND_SOURCE.md facts will be used (school name, founding year 1990, Infantil / Fundamental I e II / Medio breadth, the verbatim public taglines, the exact address/phone/email/hours, and the six named values words); no accreditation body, enrollment figure, staff name, curriculum specific, or exact visit-scheduling mechanism beyond phone/email will be invented, since none is evidenced for this prospect. Deliverable tier is early_visual_direction per the brief; this build will not be marked production-complete or ready for publication. No approval, human-approval, or publication receipt will be written by this builder.
